_notes.purpose: Shared deterministic vectors for herdr-mcp Relay/link Batch 4: (A) backoff option sanitization + peek/next/reset, (B) runtime-generation ownership/fencing state scenarios.
_notes.rng_convention: In backoff cases, `options.rng` is a constant value meaning a constant rng function returning that value (e.g. 0.5 => () => 0.5).
_notes.oracle_convention: `oracle: node_parity` means the case is directly executable against the existing TypeScript/Node implementation and must match it exactly. `oracle: rust_safety_strengthening` means the case is a desired fail-closed Rust invariant that the current Node implementation does NOT yet enforce; it is asserted for schema/intent only and must not change Node production.
_notes.no_secrets: All tokens/endpoints are synthetic test values; no real credentials.

sanitization_cases.name: negative and oversized inputs clamp to safe bounds
non-finite and fractional inputs fall back and floor

scenarios.name: active generation baseline
scenarios.description: A freshly constructed manager has the base generation active with no previous generation and no transitions.

scenarios.name: old in-flight drains on old generation after activation
scenarios.description: A request dispatched to the old generation before activation keeps draining on the old generation while new requests bind the new active.

scenarios.name: new requests bind the new active generation
scenarios.description: After activation, a fresh request is served by the candidate generation, not the old one.

scenarios.name: cancel routes to the request owner generation
scenarios.description: Cancelling a request dispatched to the old generation routes to the old generation's transport (the owner), even after activation moved the active pointer.

scenarios.name: duplicate request-id is fail-closed in Rust
scenarios.description: A second dispatch with the same request_id while the first is in flight must be rejected at the manager boundary before touching any transport. Node currently relies on the transport's duplicateRequest guard; Rust should enforce it fail-closed at the manager.
scenarios.desired_invariant: dispatchRequest must return a duplicate-request failure without forwarding to any transport when the request_id is already in flight on any generation.

scenarios.name: completion with wrong/stale serving generation is fail-closed in Rust
scenarios.description: If a request owned by generation G is completed with a claimed serving generation G' != G, the manager must fence/reject the mismatched result rather than relabel or forward it. A correct completion from the old owner G remains valid while G is draining after activation.
scenarios.desired_invariant: A completion is accepted only when its claimed serving generation exactly matches the request ownership lease; mismatch must fail closed without consuming the lease.
